encounter.title: Prologue 4 — Two Enemies / Priority (5x5 Candidate B, seed 405)
encounter.notes: LD-005 Prologue 5x5 Candidate B. Board: square5 (5x5), seed 405, 7 arrows (N4 E2 S0 W1). Urgent Grunt E (2 HP, IN 3, dmg 2) and Slow Grunt N (2 HP, IN 5, dmg 2). Clean sequence: #1(E) -> #2(N) -> #3(E) -> #0(N) kills urgent E on turn 3, slow N on turn 4 with 0 damage. Wrong priority on N leads to 2 damage from E.
